protocol.primary_outcome: Arithmetic mean energy distance over four matched targets on the neuronal Screen1_0 holdout, equally weighted across paired fit seeds 1, 2, and 3. Lower is better. A mean less than or equal to the fixed EMPF reference meets the point-estimate goal.
protocol.selection: Screen1_1 validation with Screen1_3 and Screen1_4 used to fit. Screen candidate hyperparameters at seed 0. Retest the three best completed v11 configurations by mean four-target validation energy on seed 4. Freeze the finalist with the lowest two-seed validation mean before inspecting its held-out scores.
protocol.reference: ParticleGAN 0.10.0 EMPF, base LR 0.005, 64-row batches, 64 particles, 16 latent dimensions, prior noise sigma 0.025.
protocol.additional_control: If the selected v11 changes capacity or batch size, evaluate EMPF with the selected capacity, batch size and prior noise, retaining the reference EMPF optimizer rates.
protocol.fixed: 1200 updates, condition rotation, 96-wide two-layer tanh MLPs, energy metric on 30 fit-whitened PCA coordinates, 256 clean draws per condition. Shared GPU wall times include contention.
